payload.description:
As a dashboard user, I want a dispatched evaluation to retain one evaluation identity from submission through completion, so that realtime task state, progress, results, and terminal outcome appear on the evaluation I started.

Feature: Stable evaluation identity for dispatched runs

Scenario: A feedback evaluation completes successfully
Given the dashboard has created an evaluation and a task targeting that evaluation
When a worker executes the task
Then the worker updates that same evaluation record
And the task and evaluation both become completed
And the dashboard displays the terminal outcome and execution progress on the requested evaluation

Scenario: A feedback evaluation fails
Given the dashboard has created an evaluation and a task targeting that evaluation
When the worker cannot execute the evaluation
Then the worker records the failure on that same evaluation and task
And the dashboard displays the failure rather than an announced pending state

Out of scope: a UI-only status fallback, duplicate evaluation records, or provider-specific dispatch behavior.
payload.title: Keep dashboard evaluation identity stable through execution
